labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory (CVE-2026-4539) concerning Pygments, a Rich dependency

body:
The advisory in this report (CVE-2026-4539) is about Pygments, which Rich depends on, rather than about Rich's own code. The `requests` advisory is in a package that pip-audit uses; Rich does not depend on `requests`.

Pygments is a separate project, so the advisory is best followed up there. If you think Rich itself is affected, please report it privately as described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
